purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask where tokens, money, or time went across past agent sessions, or which failures repeat; near misses belong to sibling skills or to ccusage.

cases.prompt: where did all my tokens and money go last month
cases.assert: Runs waste.py --since 30d and leads with its headline, then the top waste rows with their fixes.

cases.prompt: why is my Claude Code bill so high
cases.assert: Runs the report for Claude Code, ranks waste by dollars, and says the dollars are API list prices.

cases.prompt: which habits waste the most tokens in my agent sessions
cases.assert: Reports the waste table ranked by dollars and picks fixes from references/fixes.md.

cases.prompt: how much am I losing to cache misses and repeated file reads
cases.assert: Reports the cache rebuild and re-read rows with tokens, dollars, and share of spend.

cases.prompt: show me the failure patterns in my Codex and Gemini CLI sessions
cases.assert: Runs the report for both harnesses and reports the failure table with rates per 100.

cases.prompt: audit my agent transcripts for wasted money
cases.assert: Runs waste.py once, leads with the headline, and quotes example evidence as data.

cases.prompt: stop the session when it loops or spends more than ten dollars
cases.assert: Belongs to runaway-guard: stopping a live session.

cases.prompt: how many tokens do my MCP servers add to every session
cases.assert: Belongs to tool-design-checker: the tool load of MCP servers.

cases.prompt: did my agent get worse after the last Claude Code update
cases.assert: Belongs to regression-finder: behavior split by version.

cases.prompt: check whether the agent really ran the tests before it said done
show my daily token totals by model
cases.assert: Plain totals belong to ccusage; this skill reports habits and failures.

cases.prompt: turn the rule my agent keeps breaking into a hook
